name: Instagram
description: Publishes new articles that have a JPEG featured image to your Instagram professional account, with a caption in the post's language, and shows your latest Instagram posts as a carousel or a grid with [instagram_feed] and as a widget. You connect the account once on this page; the 60-day token renews itself.
author: sap13ns

widgets.title: Instagram feed
widgets.description: Your latest Instagram posts, as a carousel or a grid.

config.label: Number of posts
config.help: 1 to 24. Empty uses the plugin settings.

purpose.en: The Instagram feed's images load from Instagram's servers with the page: Meta receives your IP address. They set no cookies, and nothing else loads from Meta.
purpose.es: Las imágenes del feed de Instagram se cargan desde los servidores de Instagram con la página: Meta recibe tu dirección IP. No crean cookies, y no se carga nada más de Meta.

settings.label: Instagram app ID
settings.help: From your app in the Meta App Dashboard → Instagram → API setup with Instagram login → Business login settings. Save, then connect the account under Connections.

settings.label: Instagram app secret
settings.help: The Instagram app secret shown next to it (not the Meta app secret of App settings → Basic).

settings.label: Publish new posts
settings.help: Publish new articles that have a featured image to Instagram. Off keeps only the feed.

settings.label: Caption
settings.help: Placeholders: {title} {url} {excerpt} {hashtags} {site}. Empty uses “New post: {title}”, the excerpt, “Link in bio.” and the hashtags, in the post's language. Links in captions are not clickable on Instagram.

settings.label: Caption for Spanish posts
settings.help: Used instead of the caption above for posts in Spanish.

settings.label: Caption for English posts
settings.help: Used instead of the caption above for posts in English.

settings.label: Hashtags
settings.help: How many of the post's tags become hashtags (at most 20). 0 adds none.

settings.label: Post
settings.help: Which content types are published when they go live.

settings.label: Skip posts older than (hours)
settings.help: A post whose publication date is older than this is never published, so re-publishing an old article does not announce it again.

settings.label: Dry run
settings.help: Write the caption that would be published to the activity log instead of publishing it. The feed is still refreshed.

settings.label: Posts in the feed
settings.help: 1 to 24. For [instagram_feed] without count=. The widget has its own setting.

settings.label: Show the privacy note
settings.help: A short note under each feed that says the images load from Instagram (Meta).

settings.label: Privacy policy link
settings.help: https://…, http://… or a site path such as /privacy. Adds a “Privacy policy” link after the note.
